Man Dies After Car Catches Fire in Thiruvananthapuram

A man died after his car caught fire on the road in Venganoor, Thiruvananthapuram. Onlookers reportedly watched helplessly as the vehicle burned. The incident occurred after a family dispute allegedly took place at his home in Kottayam prior to his journey. The specific cause of the fire remains under investigation.
